evidence.observation: pressure_gauge not_installed; growth stage requires tube pressure gauge, so atmosphere cannot be verified
Ramp tracked setpoint; small overshoot to 760.4 at growth start, settled at 750.0 with heater power steady at ~44%
Ar steady at ~100 sccm, matching setpoint
O2 purged down to ~3-4 ppm and stayed there; no sign of an air leak

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure readings (an installed gauge or a manual gauge check) would confirm the atmosphere and rule out an exhaust blockage or pressure fault, which O2 and flow readings cannot detect. Post-run characterization of the sample is also still needed.
